[h1]Updates - Build #520[/h1]
Build #520 went out quietly today. This patch was mostly for the tutorial and how new players progress through the starting screens. There are still a few updates for current players.

Here is the list...
- 80t road now has a teal center line which makes it stick out from the 40t road.
- Dragging a truck for industries shows a difference between fully maxed and upgradable industries. The fully maxed industries are more vibrant.
- Some trucks for sale in Brazil with more "Loaders", as requested.
- Trucks in Brazil are arranged by colour within the shops to show what power they have.
- New low priority message type for when trucks can't use route or are busy.
- Auto close low priority messages when dragging map or truck.
- Dim trucks on map when dragging. Was working for good trucks, but not damaged ones.

[h1]Tutorial Updates[/h1]
- New tutorial start to begin at the Globe.
- Gave towns descriptive names to help new players.
- Corrected "Click Town" to "Click Here" on Flinders Island tutorial
- Made zero population towns that have industry show as towns on the map.
- Show zero population towns that have industries (eg. ABCDEF in tutorial)
- Other tutorial bits
